# Platform marks

Official platform icons fetched 2026-09-19, unchanged, for identifying the corresponding external profile link. Exact asset sources are recorded in sources.json. Marks belong to their respective owners; this directory does not claim MIT licensing or platform endorsement. No CSS recoloring or cropping is applied.

ORCID iD icon: https://orcid.org/assets/vectors/orcid.logo.icon.svg ; guidelines https://info.orcid.org/brand-guidelines/ . ORCID, the ORCID logo and iD logo are trademarks of ORCID, Inc.
GitHub: https://github.githubassets.com/favicons/favicon.svg ; https://brand.github.com/foundations/logo .
Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/favicon.ico .
DBLP: https://dblp.org/img/dblp.icon.192x192.png .
CNKI: https://www.cnki.net/favicon.ico .

All images are served locally; no third-party icon requests occur when visiting the faculty pages. Personal homepage uses the existing Bootstrap Icons external-link symbol (MIT), not a made-up platform mark.
